invariants.task: Original task, context, history, selected repo/ref, model/provider, thinking and quota controls preserved.
invariants.remoteSource: One target and up to three dependent bodies; 32,000 characters per body; exact remote origin/repo/requested-path admission; late reads ignored after soft gather budget or Stop.
invariants.quote: One shared exact contiguous-byte/coordinate owner. Correct range disambiguates repeats; coordinate repair requires unique exact span. Reject altered/malformed/unopened/mixed-identity/ambiguous evidence.
invariants.finalPublication: Recheck captured windows without reread; reject altered, downgraded or removed validated quotes; persist known cost on failure.
invariants.repairTrigger: Objective incomplete/empty/cutoff/unclosed-fence output or invalid explicit source quotation.
invariants.renderAndCopy: Persisted explicit citation mode uses the shared Markdown parser; original code/fences and anonymous examples retain their identity.
invariants.stopAndUsage: No follow-up request or publication after Stop; known completed costs retained, unknown usage not represented as zero, differing actual models reported per call.

semanticBoundary: Prompt policy constrains behavioral claims. Exact quote checks do not certify model semantic correctness, symbol binding, full reachability or complete coverage.

peerValidation.reported: Knowledge Gaps full suite and lint green, including real final-publication -> store -> restore checks and explicit citation mode retention.
peerValidation.candidateScope: Latest Knowledge Gaps-specific discovery/source-budget edits are separately qualified in that chat's candidate and are not represented as part of this Blast snapshot.
